{{Quote|I am Grataa. It is my honor to represent the Great Hunt. I have been investigating possible malfeasance by one Tarro Blood.|Grataa|<ref name="TOR:MS" />}}
'''Grataa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]] representative who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the one who accepted an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] into the Great Hunt on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] companion, nicknamed him "Skullface".

==Biography==
{{Quote|I reviewed your security holorecording and witnessed the murder of your teammates by Tarro's men. While dishonorable, the attack wasn't technically against the rules. Unless Tarro attacks another competitor, he cannot be punished.|Grataa, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:MS" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Grataa came to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to the palace of [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to watch the process of elimination. When one of the participants, [[Tarro Blood]], murdered [[Braden]] and [[Jory]], Grataa was able to watch the recording of the incident and began an investigation. When he met the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Rarsk]], he gave the selected [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] instructions for the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]]. However, [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] grew suspicious after she and her companion killed Rarsk who was tracking a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]. Upon returning to the palace, Mako initially reacted nervously at his presence, but the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] calmed her and explained the motives of their actions. He then gave the hunter and Mako a pass to enter a shuttle which would take them to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the capital of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Since Blood did not break the tournament rules, Grataa promised to keep an eye out for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]].<ref name="TOR:MS" />
